candidates.text: The owner should be able to recover donated assets from a vault so the balance can be zeroed and unregisterVault can proceed.
evidence_ids: A more direct and practical solution is to provide a way for the owner to recover donated assets from a vault. Add a privileged `sweep` function to the `WERC7575Vault.sol` contract. This function would allow the owner to withdraw a specified amount of the asset token, enabling them to zero out the balance and proceed with unregistering the vault.
With this function, the owner can remove the dust assets sent by an attacker and successfully call `unregisterVault`, mitigating the DoS vector.
